personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT fused with 1 iOS-Native Clean
personality_one_liner: An energetic, trustworthy, and fast exam-prep experience that balances playful, tactile navigation with high-focus, clinical testing environments.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile padding on home/hubs, strict functional padding in test player. Avoid unneeded nesting margins.

do's: Bottom tab bar behind floating diamond

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary landing showing 2x2 exam tile grid and the All India Series banner.
screens.layout: Top-aligned content. 2x2 grid (flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between', width roughly 48% per tile) of large white rounded tiles. Below it, the All India JEE Mains Test Series banner in deep shining blue (#0B2D80). The banner contains an absolutely positioned 45-degree ribbon '100% AI' top-right (burgundy), and an inner pale block (#FFF5F3) for the tagline. Bottom bar must support a custom center half-out diamond for LIVE.

screens.name: Rapid Fire
screens.purpose: Tinder-like swipable flashcard quiz for fast-paced practice.
screens.layout: Full-screen experience. A single prominent card in the center (Reanimated + GestureHandler). User taps one of 4 short options to lock, then swipes right for next or left to skip. Includes a 20-second timer ring at the top. Background can be a subtle gradient to add depth.

screens.name: Test Player
screens.purpose: High-focus, clinically clean interface for taking the actual exam.
screens.layout: Strictly functional. White reading surface. Subject tabs (Physics, Chemistry, Math) using their specific colors. Question palette (grid of small numbered squares with states). Action bar fixed at bottom (Save & Next, Clear). Server timer top right.

screens.name: Results & Solutions
screens.layout: Tabbed view (Analysis, Progress, Confidence, Rank, Solutions). Solutions tab uses a horizontal question number rail below subject tabs. Content area shows one question and its detailed AI-generated solution.

screens.name: Mission
screens.purpose: Share the app's vision and encourage sharing among students.
screens.layout: Editorial-style scroll. Full-width banner explaining the AI PYQ analysis (80 parameters), followed by a primary call-to-action to share the app.

tile_jee.alt: Abstract colorful 3d shape for JEE Main

tile_live.alt: Abstract colorful 3d shape for Live Series

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the user-requested custom colors (JEE Main glossy blood red #D92525, BITSAT orange #F97316, COMEDK black #000000, All India Series #0B2D80, Burgundy #991B1B) overriding any standard rules, as the user explicitly provided these hexes/names.
Implement the Home screen with a 2x2 grid (using flexWrap and ~48% width). Tiles must be large, white (surfaceSecondary), with rounded corners (lg/xl).

Build the All India Series banner on Home exactly as requested: background #0B2D80, a 45-degree ribbon top-right (use absolute positioning and transform: rotate(45deg) and overflow hidden on parent), and an inner pale block #FFF5F3.

The Bottom Tab Bar requires a custom diamond-shaped center button for 'LIVE' that is half-raised out of the bar. You will need to build a custom tab bar component (or highly customize the bottom-tabs standard one) utilizing absolute positioning and z-index for the diamond.

For the Rapid Fire screen, implement Tinder-like swipe physics using react-native-reanimated and react-native-gesture-handler. A single active card at a time that supports swipe right (next) and swipe left (skip).
The Test Player must be hyper-functional with a stark white background for high readability, using the specific subject colors (#2459D8, #087B68, #B92B45) for their respective tabs.
